source.installed_package: celltypist 1.7.1, non-editable in celltypist-env; `diff -r repo/celltypist/celltypist <site-packages>/celltypist -x __pycache__` reports no differences, so the line numbers below hold for both

runtime.CELLTYPIST_FOLDER: Read by celltypist.models at import (models.py:16-20): models_path is fixed when celltypist is first imported. The module never sets it, and the server process or test harness must export it before import. Default upstream: ~/.celltypist.
runtime.stdout: Checked, no redirect added. celltypist logs through logging.basicConfig (logger.py:2), whose default stream is stderr. The package source contains no print(). Both smoke runs captured fd 1 of the whole process to a file: 0 bytes (logs/smoke_attempt1_stdout.txt, logs/smoke_attempt1_branches_stdout.txt). That covers annotate with Leiden over-clustering, training with n_jobs=10 (joblib workers inherit fd 1), violin plotting and FastMCP's error tracebacks, which go to stderr.
runtime.output_dirs: _fresh_output_dir(): tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='<tool>_<YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS>_', dir=<output_dir or $TMPDIR/celltypist_mcp_outputs>) inside every call; created only after inputs validate and the upstream computation succeeds. Repeated identical annotate calls landed in distinct directories (smoke annotate_repeat).

shared_helpers._resolve_model: Used by annotate and inspect. A string containing '/' is a model file path (expanduser+resolve, must exist), mirroring Model.load's own name/path rule (models.py:91). Otherwise it is a built-in name. If $CELLTYPIST_FOLDER/data/models/<name> is missing, the helper calls models.download_models(model=name) (models.py:474-517), which fetches only that model, plus models.json if absent. It raises ValueError for a name absent from the index. Afterwards the helper checks the file exists and raises RuntimeError if the download failed. That check matters because download_models only logs download errors (models.py:516-517), and a following Model.load -> get_all_models -> download_if_required (models.py:407-429) would otherwise download all 61 models whenever the cache holds no .pkl. The name itself, not the path, is then passed on to celltypist, as in tutorial cell 28.
shared_helpers._h5ad_path: Resolves the path. Requires an existing file with suffix .h5ad. This is needed because the wrapper reads the file with sc.read and passes an AnnData, and upstream treats an in-memory AnnData as already log1p-normalised. A .csv/.mtx would therefore skip upstream's raw-count normalisation (classifier.py:278-306), so non-h5ad input is rejected with a clear error.

refresh_index.source: scanner tool_review; the tutorial's download_models(force_update=True) in cell 16 refreshes the index. The tool deliberately never downloads models.

celltypist_list_models.outputs: models_description.csv: the upstream DataFrame written with to_csv(index=False), columns exactly [model, description]. Returns n_models, default_model, index_path, and models (the same rows as records, which is the content an agent picks a model from).
celltypist_list_models.deviations: Never calls download_models() without a model name. Tutorial cell 16 downloaded every model (12 then, 61 now). Listing needs only the index, and the first call downloads models.json if it is not cached (models.py:447-449).

upstream_calls: scanpy.read(<h5ad>), the same reader celltypist uses for an .h5ad path (classifier.py:308)

over_clustering_key.source: annotate.py:17, 92-97. Restricted to an obs key (the upstream plain-text-file fallback at 98-105 is not exposed). Validated only when majority_voting=True, because upstream ignores it otherwise.

parameters.not_exposed: transpose_input, gene_file, cell_file (only for non-h5ad inputs); use_GPU (no GPU stack); insert_conf_by (not in the coordinator spec)

io_adaptations: Input is read once with sc.read and the AnnData is passed to annotate, as the tutorial does with adata_2000. This allows the over_clustering_key column check (metadata-input rule) without reading the file twice.

Composition contract with celltypist_tutorial_ml.celltypist_compare_with_reference: the fresh output_dir holds exactly predicted_labels.csv, decision_matrix.csv, probability_matrix.csv (written by to_table, no prefix, no xlsx) and annotated.h5ad (to_adata(insert_labels=True, insert_conf=True), no probabilities). Its absolute path is returned as `output_dir`, and the artifacts list carries all four paths.
Probabilities are not inserted into the h5ad: 11 of 98 Immune_All_Low cell-type names contain '/', which anndata 0.13 rejects or warns about as obs keys.

annotated.h5ad keeps upstream side effects: X_pca, connectivities, distances, uns['neighbors'] and uns['over_clustering'] when celltypist built the over-clustering. An existing neighbour graph in the input is reused (classifier.py:435-440).
celltypist_annotate_cells.returns: message, reference, artifacts[4], output_dir, n_cells, n_model_cell_types, model, model_file, mode, majority_voting_requested, majority_voting_performed, label_frequencies{predicted_labels[, majority_voting]: [{celltype, counts}]}, plus p_thres (prob match) and over_clustering_source, n_over_clusters, min_prop (when majority voting ran)
celltypist_annotate_cells.deviations: None in computation. When celltypist skips majority voting for <=50 cells, the message says so and majority_voting_performed=false.

top_n.source: models.py:174 upstream default (tutorial uses 3); must be >=1, because upstream slices [:top_n] and a negative value would silently drop genes

groupby_key.source: required with adata_path; validated against obs (tutorial: 'cell_type' on training data, 'majority_voting' on annotated query data)

io_adaptations: top_markers.csv (cell_type, rank, gene) for every selected cell type; the same markers are returned inline as top_markers.

Violin plots are drawn only when adata_path is given. cell_types must then be listed explicitly, which avoids one plot for each of up to ~100 model types. One PNG is written per listed cell type: violin_<NN>_<sanitised name>.png.

Genes absent from the plotted matrix are dropped from the plot and reported in genes_missing_from_adata. The plotted matrix is adata.raw when present, matching scanpy's check_use_raw default. When no gene is present, the plot is skipped.
celltypist_inspect_model.returns: message, reference, artifacts, output_dir, model, model_file, description, n_cell_types, n_features, cell_types, top_markers, plus groupby_key and genes_missing_from_adata when adata_path is given

for_verifier: Direct-upstream comparisons should load the same model bytes: Immune_All_Low.pkl sha256 290874d3... (notebooks/celltypist_tutorial/data). A fresh CELLTYPIST_FOLDER without that file makes the tool download the current build.
Composition with celltypist_tutorial_ml depends on the exact four file names in output_dir; test that tool on this tool's real output.

_resolve_model's guard against downloading all models is the main non-trivial wrapper logic. Check it with an empty CELLTYPIST_FOLDER, e.g. an unknown name should raise without network downloads of other models (here models_cache_after held only Immune_All_Low.pkl + models.json).
Missing-column errors are raised as KeyError, so FastMCP renders the message inside quotes. This is cosmetic.
majority_voting results depend on the scanpy/igraph/leidenalg versions. They are exact here (scanpy 1.12.4, leidenalg 0.12.0, igraph 1.0.0).
Seeded training is bit-identical only at the same n_jobs (10 used here).
